# apm-workspace

`~/.apm` is the working copy and operational source of truth for the global APM workspace of `jey3dayo`.
It owns the global manifest (`apm.yml`), the lockfile (`apm.lock.yaml`), the cache-only `apm_modules/`, personal skill sources, and the shared runtime guidance package (`catalog/`).

## Where to read

- `README.md`: human overview and day-to-day flow
- `AGENTS.md`: full contract, guardrails, and edit surfaces
- `docs/apm-task-coverage.md`: every `mise` task and what gates it
- `docs/skill-inventory.md`: skill lanes (global, catalog, optional, manual, private, repo-local)
- `docs/package-decisions.md`: why each package was added, kept, or removed
- `docs/skill-overlaps.md`: which of several similar skills to use
- `docs/learning-ledger.md`: changes applied by `learning-intake`, graded on whether they worked
- `catalog/.apm/skills/apm-usage/SKILL.md`: operating guidance for agents
- `todo.txt` / `done.txt`: open and finished internal tasks

## Key rules (details in AGENTS.md)

- Edit personal skills in `catalog/.apm/skills/**`, copied skills in `manual-skills/**`, shared guidance in `catalog/**`.
- `private-skills/**` is gitignored here; its source of truth is a private repo.
- Treat `apm.yml` / `apm.lock.yaml` as command-managed; add or remove external skills with `apm install` / `apm uninstall`.
- Never edit `apm_modules/` or deployed targets in place.
- The `apm` version is pinned in `mise.toml`; read it there instead of trusting a quoted version.
- Routine rollout is `mise run deploy`; run `mise run check` before pushing.
